question: What prevents liberation in saṃsāra for those lacking the Akula Hero?
premises: They are not liberated in saṃsāra
They are deprived of the Akula Hero
Absence of the Akula Hero blocks liberation
inference: Those deprived of the Akula Hero do not attain liberation in saṃsāra.
plain_english: They are not liberated in saṃsāra, being deprived of the Akula Hero.
